description: How this year compares with last year and the years before: are we up or down on last year, revenue and profit trend, margin, cash at year end, year on year, same time last year, how did last year go. Returns the completed years (from the ledger or the filed accounts), the current year to date against the same months last year, and Finn's read of the trend. Use it before any 'how are we doing', planning or forecasting answer when the company has history.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.
